manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the smooth plastic tabletrashbin, pour balls into the bin.

Task description: Pick up the smooth light-colored plastic mini trash can containing red balls at the front-left of the view and pour them into the large trash can on the left side of the table. Finish while holding the small bin high.

Success criteria: All 5 red balls must leave the small bucket and land low inside the large bin on the left, near its bottom. The small bucket must remain clearly raised above the table; a slight lift is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's straight upper wall away from rounded corners and the ball-pouring outlet, with one finger inside and one outside. Match the opening to wall thickness and ensure full pad contact to reduce slippage on the smooth surface.
- Before closing, confirm both fingers are on opposite sides of the bin wall rather than both outside or pressing only on its upper rim. During a slight test lift, check whether the bin slides down or tilts.
- Keep the bucket opening upward during transport and avoid abrupt stops, preventing the red balls from rolling out before reaching the large bucket opening.
- Only part of the large left bin is initially visible. Use live observations to confirm opening boundaries, position the small bucket's pouring rim above the opening interior and leave rotation clearance to reduce rim collisions and balls falling outside.
- Gradually increase the tilt while pouring. If balls remain on the bottom or in a corner, gently shake the container while keeping its outlet directed into the large bucket; avoid vigorous shaking that could cause slipping or send a ball flying out.
